name: Epoetin beta
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Epoetin beta is an erythropoiesis-stimulating agent (ESA) for anemia of chronic kidney failure; it is not dosed by kidney function but titrated to hemoglobin (Hb), with a European target of 10 to 12 g/dL and a rise of no more than 2 g/dL in 4 weeks. Higher Hb targets raise the risk of death, stroke and cardiovascular events. It has no US FDA label (the related methoxy polyethylene glycol-epoetin beta does).
kidney_function_basis: Dose follows hemoglobin, not kidney function. Bands shown on creatinine clearance (CrCl).

bands.recommendation: No kidney dose adjustment; dose is titrated to hemoglobin. Correction: 20 IU/kg SC three times weekly (or 40 IU/kg IV three times weekly), increased every 4 weeks if Hb rises less than 0.25 g/dL per week; maximum 720 IU/kg/week. Target Hb 10 to 12 g/dL (SmPC).

hd: Same Hb-titrated dosing; IV (40 IU/kg three times weekly to start) or SC. Heparin needs often rise on dialysis; watch for access thrombosis (SmPC).
crrt: Not studied in acute kidney injury or CRRT; ESAs are not used for acute anemia. Specialist input.
dialyzable: Not applicable (large glycoprotein; not removed by dialysis in a clinically relevant way). Not stated in the SmPC.
monitoring: Hb regularly (avoid sustained Hb above 12 g/dL; reduce dose about 25% if Hb rises more than 2 g/dL in a month or nears 12). Blood pressure, especially early and between dialysis sessions. Platelets during the first 8 weeks. Potassium and phosphate. Iron status before and during therapy. Sudden Hb fall with low reticulocytes: stop and test for anti-erythropoietin antibodies (pure red cell aplasia) (SmPC 4.2, 4.4).

pediatric.approved_ages: Children with anemia of chronic kidney failure; multidose formulation (benzyl alcohol) not under 3 years (EMA).
pediatric.usual_dose: Same weight-based schedule as adults; younger children often need higher doses (SmPC).

sources.citation: European Medicines Agency. (2023). NeoRecormon (epoetin beta): EPAR product information [Summary of product characteristics; last updated March 15, 2023]. Roche Registration GmbH.

adult: Retrieved the Italian-language EMA product information (English link cited). KDIGO 2012 anemia guideline (Hb ≤11.5) is stricter than the SmPC target; Dr. Rivero may want KDIGO wording added.
